handoff.salientSummary: Implemented the Reservation Book, Host Stand, and Guest backend endpoints and services across tenant-api and App: /operator/reservations/book/*, /operator/reservations/guests/*, section layouts CRUD, /internal/reservations/summary + /resources/reservations/region-summary, and idempotent seed:reservations demo data. All 39 assertions, unit/route/concurrency/security tests, live :3007/:3009 checks, typecheck, and lint pass.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
1. Implemented Guest Service (`apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-guest-service.ts`) and `/operator/reservations/guests/*` router (`apps/tenant-api/src/routes/operator-reservations-guests.ts`): guest lookup/search by name/phone/email, guest creation with E.164 phone and normalized email dedupe, guest summary with recent bookings and stats, JSON export (`GET /guests/:id/export` gating sensitive fields on `includeSensitive=1` + `update:reservation_guest:any` and writing `guest.export` audit log), and right-to-erasure (`POST /guests/:id/erase` anonymizing profile to "Removed Guest", deleting notes/tags, cancelling future bookings and releasing table occupancies, scrubbing waitlist/messages/payments, redacting `rsv_reservation_events.data` and `rsv_audit_log.changes` to `{"redacted":true}`, and writing `guest.erase` audit log without PII).
2. Implemented Day Feed, Calendar, Pre-Service Overview, Service Notes, Section Assignments, and Regional Summary Service (`apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-day-feed-service.ts`):
   - `GET /operator/reservations/book/day` with composite ETag `"<locationId>:<date>:<dayVersion>:<settingsVersion>"` and `304 Not Modified` on `If-None-Match`.
   - `GET /operator/reservations/book/changes` returning `{ dayVersion, changed }`.
   - `GET /operator/reservations/book/availability` returning staff slots (including `staff_only` and `walk_in_only` tables) and `pacingWarning` indicators.
   - `GET /operator/reservations/book/calendar` returning per-day party/cover counts, peak-slot utilization, and special-day markers.
   - `GET /operator/reservations/book/overview` returning VIPs, allergies (with allergy text redacted to `null` when operator lacks `read:reservation_guest:any` while keeping `hasAllergy: true`), occasions, large parties, special requests, payment flags, and service notes.
   - `GET/PUT/POST /operator/reservations/book/service-notes` with `expectedVersion` (409 `stale_version`).
   - `GET/PUT/POST /operator/reservations/book/section-assignments` supporting both `staff_id` and free-text `server_label`.
3. Implemented Booking & Host Stand Service (`apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-booking-service.ts`) and `/operator/reservations/book/*` router (`apps/tenant-api/src/routes/operator-reservations-book.ts`):
   - `POST /reservations` and `POST /walk-ins` enforcing `Idempotency-Key`, serialized through `withReservationWrite`, auto-assigning best-fit tables (`assignTables` engine), supporting audited `overbook: true` + `overbookReason`, and preventing double-allocation under concurrent last-table races.
   - `GET /reservations/:id`, `PATCH /reservations/:id` (time/duration/party/area/table drag/resize with soft-booking reflow and `moves[]`), `POST /reservations/:id/assign` (`Assign` soft, `Assign & Lock` locked, `unlock: true`, 2-party atomic swap, soft-booking reflow outside `freeze_min` returning `moves[]`, overbook), `POST /reservations/:id/status` (state machine enforcement, `covers_actual`, occupancy release, guest visit/cover/cancel/no_show counters), `POST /reservations/:id/undo` (including 30-min `finished -> seated` window and table occupancy re-check returning 409 `table_occupied`), and `/contact`, `/running-late`, `/course`, `/notes` updates with `expectedVersion` (409 `stale_version`) and append-only `rsv_reservation_events`.
4. Implemented Section Layouts CRUD in `apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-setup-crud.ts` and `apps/tenant-api/src/routes/operator-reservations-setup.ts` (`GET/POST /locations/:id/sections`, `PATCH/DELETE /locations/:id/sections/:layoutId`) enforcing unique table membership (`400 table_in_multiple_sections`).
5. Implemented internal regional summary endpoints (`POST /internal/reservations/summary` and `POST /internal/reservations/location-summary` in `apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-internal.ts`) and App resource route (`GET /resources/reservations/region-summary` in `apps/app/app/routes/resources+/reservations.region-summary.ts` with `regional-internal.server.ts`, `region-confirmation.ts`, and `region-guard.server.ts`).
6. Extended `apps/tenant-api/scripts/seed-reservations.ts` to seed built-in tags, guest tags, a 3-server dinner section layout, today's server section assignments, pre-service notes, reservation tags, and valid reservation statuses (`arrived`, `finished`).
